title: Long-Standing Policy Fee Concession — Term Life Insurance Installment Newly Due in Grace
content:
Term Life Insurance grants a long-standing fee concession in the newly due installment counted in a grace remittance, by the policy years the policy has completed — the whole years from the issue date to today.

| Policy years completed | Concession |
|---|---|
| 20 or more | 10.00 |
| 10 through 19 | 5.00 |
| fewer than 10 | nothing |

The concession is taken off the fee before sharing; the policy fee never falls below nothing.

**Examples (hypothetical).**

- Issue date 1 June 2006, today 31 May 2026: 19 whole years completed — 5.00.
- Issue date 1 June 2006, today 1 June 2026: 20 whole years completed — 10.00.
- Issue date 1 June 2016, today 31 May 2026: 9 whole years completed — nothing.
